title: Thumbnail Concepts
description: Structured output of the thumbnail-concepts LLM call, before persist_thumbnail_concepts(). Persisted BEFORE any rendering/generation call — see docs/architecture/publication-package-pipeline.md#thumbnail-concepts. Top-level array must contain at least 3 entries.

source_asset_id.description: Required when source_asset_strategy is existing_asset/composite — an asset_id from the already-approved visual shot list, never invented.

source_frame_timestamp_ms.description: Required when source_asset_strategy is video_frame — a timestamp within the final video's actual duration.

overlay_text.description: 0-5 words recommended. Never a duplicate of the full title.

generation_prompt.description: Required when source_asset_strategy is generated_image, null otherwise.

factual_risk_notes.description: Null if no factual-accuracy risk. Otherwise describes exactly what a real-person/real-event depiction shows and why it is not deceptive — see docs/architecture/publication-package-pipeline.md#real-people-events.
